title: Pathophysiology Analysis of "Costello Syndrome" on Cellular Models
brief_summary: The objective is to collect skin biopsies rom patients with Costello syndrome to analyze the molecular mechanisms responsible for this syndrome caused by a mutation in the HRAS gene and the effects of this mutation on energy metabolism and mitochondrial physiology.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children aged over 2 years and under 18
* Children with a Costello Syndrome or Syndrome Cardio-Facio-Cutaneous

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous history allergic to anesthetics
